verdict.rationale: Airwallex documents a public API for programmatic use. It covers creating connected accounts, scoped API keys with Read/Write permissions per API, and bearer-token authentication guidance aimed at AI agents. The official CLI exposes a broad slice of the API and lets you explore endpoints and schemas interactively, and a full API-accessible sandbox supports testing. Missing for 10: a directly cited API reference or OpenAPI spec, and independent or hands-on corroboration of API usage (probes only confirm llms.txt, the CLI and the MCP docs).
